item_name: Rothco 3 Color OCP Camo Face Paint Compact
item_short_desc: Ideal For Hunting And Military Applications, Rothco's 3 Color OCP (Operational Camouflage Pattern) Camo Face Paint Compact Features Brown, Tan, And Loam Colors - Designed To Work With Operational Camouflage Pattern/Scorpion.
description: Ideal for hunting and military applications, Rothco's 3 color OCP (Operational Camouflage Pattern) Camo Face Paint compact features brown, tan, and loam colors - Designed To Work With Operational Camouflage Pattern/Scorpion. The compact features a mirror for easy application on the go. Pocket sized and made with camouflage plastic casing (3" x 2 1/4"). Contains lanolin oil and mineral oil - NO nut oils used.
